english: Is there anything else you need before the client meeting?
chinese: 客戶會議前你還需要什麼嗎？

english: Please enter your date of birth on the insurance application form.
chinese: 請在保險申請表上填寫您的出生日期。

english: The new manager brought several fresh ideas to the sales team.
chinese: 新經理為業務團隊帶來了幾個新點子。

english: Our company now has branch offices in more than twenty countries.
chinese: 我們公司目前在二十多個國家設有分公司。

english: Please check the date on the invoice before you make the payment.
chinese: 付款前請確認發票上的日期。

english: The guests drank a toast to the success of the new company.
chinese: 賓客們舉杯祝賀新公司成功。

english: Most employees eat lunch in the company cafeteria.
chinese: 大多數員工都在公司餐廳吃午餐。

english: The fact that sales rose by 15% surprised the board.
chinese: 銷售額成長了 15%，這個事實讓董事會感到意外。

english: The sales director will fly to Tokyo next Monday to meet the client.
chinese: 業務總監下週一將飛往東京與客戶會面。

english: A group of visitors from our Singapore office will tour the factory today.
chinese: 新加坡辦公室的一群訪客今天將參觀工廠。

english: The hotel serves fresh honey with its breakfast buffet.
chinese: 飯店的自助早餐附有新鮮蜂蜜。

english: The farm sells honey and jam at the weekend market.
chinese: 這座農場在週末市集販售蜂蜜和果醬。

english: The receptionist kept all the visitor records in a locked cabinet.
chinese: 櫃台人員把所有訪客紀錄都保存在上鎖的櫃子裡。

english: The new printer uses less ink than the old model.
chinese: 新的印表機比舊機型用的墨水更少。

english: I would love to join the planning committee for the company picnic.
chinese: 我很樂意加入公司野餐的籌備委員會。

english: The company saved a lot of money by switching to a new supplier.
chinese: 公司換了新的供應商，省下了一大筆錢。

english: Please do not send cash or money orders by regular mail.
chinese: 請勿以平信寄送現金或匯票。

english: I will contact the supplier myself to confirm the delivery date.
chinese: 我會親自聯絡供應商確認交貨日期。

english: None of the applicants had experience with the new accounting software.
chinese: 沒有一位應徵者用過這套新的會計軟體。

english: We organized the training workshop ourselves to save costs.
chinese: 為了節省成本，我們自己籌辦了這場培訓工作坊。

english: The hotel is a convenient place to stay for business travelers.
chinese: 對商務旅客來說，這家飯店是很方便的住宿地點。

english: The road to the warehouse will be closed for repairs this weekend.
chinese: 通往倉庫的道路本週末將因維修而封閉。

english: Our second quarter results were better than expected.
chinese: 我們第二季的業績比預期好。

english: After his vacation, he came back to work feeling like his old self again.
chinese: 休假回來後，他工作時又恢復了原本的自己。

english: I sent the revised contract to the client this morning.
chinese: 我今天早上已將修改後的合約寄給客戶。

english: Getting enough sleep helps employees stay focused at work.
chinese: 充足的睡眠能幫助員工在工作時保持專注。

english: The new office has plenty of space for meetings and events.
chinese: 新辦公室有充足的空間可以開會和舉辦活動。

english: The hotel received a five-star rating from the travel guide.
chinese: 這家飯店獲得了旅遊指南的五星評等。

english: Remember to brush your teeth after lunch before meeting clients.
chinese: 和客戶見面前，記得午餐後刷牙。

english: The company ships its products to customers all over the world.
chinese: 這家公司把產品運送到世界各地的客戶手中。

english: Yes, I can attend the meeting tomorrow afternoon.
chinese: 好的，我明天下午可以出席會議。

english: Once all passengers are aboard, the plane will leave the gate.
chinese: 所有乘客登機後，飛機就會離開登機門。

english: We made a small adjustment to the schedule so everyone can attend.
chinese: 我們稍微調整了時程，讓每個人都能出席。

english: Moving to a new country requires some adjustment for employees and their families.
chinese: 搬到新的國家，員工和家人都需要一些時間適應。

english: Admission to the museum is free for children under 12.
chinese: 12 歲以下兒童可免費入館參觀。

english: The government offered financial aid to small businesses affected by the storm.
chinese: 政府為受暴風雨影響的小型企業提供財務援助。

english: All staff must complete a first aid course this year.
chinese: 所有員工今年都必須完成急救課程。

english: The aim of the meeting is to agree on next year's budget.
chinese: 這次會議的目標是就明年的預算達成共識。

english: Our aim is to answer every customer email within 24 hours.
chinese: 我們的目標是在 24 小時內回覆每一封客戶電子郵件。

english: We have made special arrangements for guests who need wheelchair access.
chinese: 我們已為需要輪椅通道的來賓做了特別安排。

english: My laptop battery runs out after about four hours.
chinese: 我的筆電電池大約四個小時就沒電了。

english: The company does not tolerate rude behavior toward customers.
chinese: 公司不容許對顧客有無禮的行為。

english: The new website is designed to be accessible to blind users.
chinese: 新網站的設計讓視障使用者也能使用。

english: Hotel checkout time is 11 a.m., but late checkout is available on request.
chinese: 飯店退房時間是上午 11 點，但可應要求延後退房。

english: You have a choice of chicken or fish for lunch.
chinese: 午餐你可以選擇雞肉或魚。

english: The audience began to clap when the speaker finished her presentation.
chinese: 講者結束簡報時，觀眾開始鼓掌。

english: The company is building a new hotel on the east coast.
chinese: 公司正在東海岸興建一家新飯店。

english: A combination of lower prices and better service increased our sales.
chinese: 價格降低加上服務改善，讓我們的銷售額增加。

english: The report includes a comparison of last year's costs and this year's costs.
chinese: 這份報告包含去年與今年成本的比較。

english: Competition among online retailers has become very intense.
chinese: 網路零售業者之間的競爭變得非常激烈。

english: In conclusion, we recommend expanding the project to two more cities.
chinese: 總結來說，我們建議將專案擴展到另外兩個城市。

english: You will receive a confirmation email once your order has been processed.
chinese: 訂單處理完成後，您會收到一封確認電子郵件。

english: Thank you for your cooperation during the office renovation.
chinese: 感謝您在辦公室整修期間的配合。

english: The warning sign tells workers about the danger of falling objects.
chinese: 警告標誌提醒工人注意物體掉落的危險。

english: Experts say the company is in danger of losing its biggest client.
chinese: 專家表示，這家公司面臨失去最大客戶的危機。

english: The board will announce its decision on the merger next week.
chinese: 董事會將於下週公布對合併案的決定。

english: The visitor asked the receptionist for directions to the meeting room.
chinese: 訪客向櫃台人員詢問前往會議室的路線。

english: Entry to the conference hall requires a valid name badge.
chinese: 進入會議廳需要配戴有效的名牌。

english: All new employees must pass a medical examination before starting work.
chinese: 所有新進員工上班前都必須通過體格檢查。

english: The accounting examination will be held at the end of the month.
chinese: 會計考試將在月底舉行。

english: Please call me at extension 205 if you have any questions.
chinese: 如有任何問題，請撥分機 205 給我。

english: I sent a follow-up email to the client after our meeting.
chinese: 會議結束後，我寄了一封後續追蹤的電子郵件給客戶。

english: The company's social media account now has over 50,000 followers.
chinese: 公司的社群媒體帳號目前有超過五萬名追蹤者。

english: He is a loyal follower of the new management style.
chinese: 他是新管理風格的忠實追隨者。

english: Please write clearly, because the clerk could not read your handwriting.
chinese: 請寫清楚一點，因為職員看不懂你的字跡。

english: The job fair was held at the city convention center last weekend.
chinese: 就業博覽會上週末在市立會議中心舉行。

english: The factory passed its annual safety inspection last week.
chinese: 工廠上週通過了年度安全檢查。

english: The trainer gave clear instructions on how to use the new machine.
chinese: 培訓人員清楚說明了新機器的使用方法。

english: The manager gave a brief introduction before the guest speaker began.
chinese: 在客座講者開始之前，經理做了簡短的介紹。

english: The technician had to kneel on the floor to fix the cables under the desk.
chinese: 技術人員必須跪在地上修理桌子底下的線路。

english: She led the negotiations with the new supplier last month.
chinese: 她上個月主導了與新供應商的談判。

english: The truck can carry a load of up to ten tons.
chinese: 這輛卡車最多可載運十噸的貨物。

english: Please help me load the boxes into the van.
chinese: 請幫我把箱子裝上廂型車。

english: The hotel is under new management and has improved its service.
chinese: 這家飯店換了新的經營團隊，服務也有所改善。

english: Please take an accurate measurement of the window before ordering curtains.
chinese: 訂購窗簾前，請準確測量窗戶的尺寸。

english: The engineer checked every measurement on the drawing.
chinese: 工程師核對了圖面上的每一個尺寸。

english: The mechanic said the delivery van needs new brakes.
chinese: 技師說這輛送貨車需要換新的煞車。

english: We called a mechanic to repair the broken forklift.
chinese: 我們請了一位技師來修理故障的堆高機。

english: I met the new marketing director at the trade fair last year.
chinese: 我去年在商展上遇見了新的行銷總監。

english: The team met several problems during the system upgrade.
chinese: 團隊在系統升級期間遇到了幾個問題。

english: Lack of motivation can lower the productivity of the whole team.
chinese: 缺乏動力會降低整個團隊的生產力。

english: All visitors must obey the safety rules in the factory.
chinese: 所有訪客都必須遵守工廠的安全規定。

english: Drivers who do not obey traffic laws may lose their company car.
chinese: 不遵守交通規則的司機可能會被收回公司配車。

english: Is there a power outlet near the podium for my laptop?
chinese: 講台附近有可以給我筆電用的電源插座嗎？

english: The company opened a new retail outlet in the shopping mall.
chinese: 公司在購物中心開了一家新的門市。

english: We still owe the supplier $3,000 for last month's order.
chinese: 我們還欠供應商上個月訂單的三千美元。

english: I owe you an apology for missing the meeting.
chinese: 我沒出席會議，欠你一個道歉。

english: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
chinese: 款項須在發票日期後 30 天內付清。

english: You need permission from your supervisor to work from home.
chinese: 在家工作需要主管的許可。

english: Customers appreciate the politeness of our front desk staff.
chinese: 顧客很欣賞我們櫃台人員的禮貌。

english: Out of politeness, she thanked the client for the long wait.
chinese: 出於禮貌，她感謝客戶耐心久候。

english: Her presentation on the new marketing plan impressed the clients.
chinese: 她對新行銷計畫的簡報讓客戶印象深刻。

english: Working under pressure is part of the job in the newsroom.
chinese: 在新聞編輯室裡，承受壓力工作是常態。

english: The customers' reaction to the new design was very positive.
chinese: 顧客對新設計的反應非常正面。

english: What was the manager's reaction when he heard the news?
chinese: 經理聽到這個消息時有什麼反應？

english: Registration for the workshop closes on Friday.
chinese: 工作坊的報名將於星期五截止。

english: It is the team leader's responsibility to make sure the deadline is met.
chinese: 確保如期完成是團隊主管的責任。

english: After the long meeting, we took a short rest before the next session.
chinese: 長時間的會議之後，我們在下一場開始前稍作休息。

english: He bought a dozen roses for the reception desk.
chinese: 他買了一打玫瑰花放在接待櫃台。

english: The hotel lobby was decorated with fresh red roses for the event.
chinese: 飯店大廳為了這場活動布置了新鮮的紅玫瑰。

english: The salesperson explained the warranty to the customer in detail.
chinese: 銷售員向顧客詳細說明了保固內容。

english: The technician will help you with the setup of your new computer.
chinese: 技術人員會協助你設定新電腦。

english: The room setup for the conference takes about two hours.
chinese: 研討會的會場布置大約需要兩個小時。

english: After the eye surgery, his sight improved greatly.
chinese: 眼睛手術後，他的視力大幅改善。

english: The contract is not valid without the director's signature.
chinese: 這份合約沒有總監的簽名就無效。

english: Smokers must use the designated area outside the building.
chinese: 吸菸者必須使用大樓外的指定區域。

english: I had a stomach ache, so I left the office early.
chinese: 我胃痛，所以提早離開辦公室。

english: Thank you for your helpful suggestions on the report.
chinese: 謝謝你對這份報告提出的寶貴建議。

english: She is a strong supporter of flexible working hours.
chinese: 她非常支持彈性工時制度。

english: The charity thanked all its supporters for their donations.
chinese: 這個慈善機構感謝所有支持者的捐款。

english: Good teamwork helped us finish the project ahead of schedule.
chinese: 良好的團隊合作讓我們提前完成了專案。

english: The workshop focuses on communication and teamwork skills.
chinese: 這場工作坊著重於溝通與團隊合作的技巧。

english: A technician will come to repair the air conditioner tomorrow.
chinese: 明天會有一位技術員來修理冷氣。

english: The lab is hiring a technician with experience in testing equipment.
chinese: 實驗室正在招聘一名有檢測設備經驗的技術員。

english: The golf shop sells tees, balls, and gloves.
chinese: 這家高爾夫用品店販售球座、球和手套。

english: The conference was an unforgettable experience for all attendees.
chinese: 這場研討會對所有與會者來說都是難忘的經驗。

english: In his youth, the CEO worked part-time in a small bookstore.
chinese: 執行長年輕時曾在一家小書店打工。

english: Winning the industry award was a great accomplishment for the team.
chinese: 贏得產業獎項是團隊的一大成就。

english: The report lists the department's main accomplishments this year.
chinese: 這份報告列出了部門今年的主要成就。

english: The CEO thanked the staff for their achievements over the past year.
chinese: 執行長感謝員工在過去一年的成就。

english: Reaching one million users was a major achievement for the startup.
chinese: 達到一百萬名用戶是這家新創公司的一大成就。

english: The film is an adaptation of a best-selling novel.
chinese: 這部電影改編自一本暢銷小說。

english: Adaptation to the new software took the staff about a month.
chinese: 員工花了大約一個月才適應新軟體。

english: The company offers many opportunities for career advancement.
chinese: 這家公司提供許多職涯晉升的機會。

english: Recent advancements in technology have made remote work easier.
chinese: 近來的科技進步讓遠距工作變得更容易。

english: Affordability is the main concern for many first-time home buyers.
chinese: 對許多首購族來說，可負擔性是最主要的考量。

english: The two airlines formed an alliance to share routes.
chinese: 這兩家航空公司結盟共享航線。

english: Our alliance with a local partner helped us enter the market quickly.
chinese: 我們與當地夥伴的合作聯盟讓我們迅速打入市場。

english: The allocation of the marketing budget will be decided next week.
chinese: 行銷預算的分配將在下週決定。

english: Office space allocation is based on the size of each team.
chinese: 辦公空間是依照各團隊的人數來分配。

english: The tailor can make alterations to your suit by Friday.
chinese: 裁縫師可以在星期五前幫你修改西裝。

english: Any alteration to the contract must be approved by both parties.
chinese: 合約的任何變更都必須經雙方同意。

english: The analysis shows that most of our customers are under 35.
chinese: 分析顯示我們大部分的顧客都在 35 歲以下。

english: The consultant will present her analysis of the market next week.
chinese: 顧問下週將提出她對市場的分析。

english: Many employees feel anxiety before their annual review.
chinese: 許多員工在年度考核前都會感到焦慮。

english: Clear communication can reduce anxiety during a company merger.
chinese: 清楚的溝通能減少公司合併期間的焦慮。

english: The director expressed her appreciation for the team's hard work.
chinese: 總監對團隊的努力表達了感謝。

english: The sales forecast is based on the assumption that prices will stay the same.
chinese: 銷售預測是基於價格維持不變的假設。

english: You need written authorization from your manager to access these files.
chinese: 你需要主管的書面授權才能存取這些檔案。

english: The payment was declined because the card authorization failed.
chinese: 因為信用卡授權失敗，這筆付款被拒絕了。

english: Automation has greatly increased the factory's output.
chinese: 自動化大幅提高了工廠的產量。

english: Some workers worry that automation will replace their jobs.
chinese: 有些工人擔心自動化會取代他們的工作。

english: Our prices cannot be beaten by any other store in the area.
chinese: 我們的價格是這一帶其他商店都比不上的。

english: The small business hired an accountant to handle its bookkeeping.
chinese: 這家小公司聘請了一位會計師來處理記帳工作。

english: The river forms the boundary between the two counties.
chinese: 這條河是兩個郡之間的邊界。

english: Managers should respect the boundary between work and personal time.
chinese: 主管應該尊重工作與私人時間的界限。

english: A breakdown in communication caused the delay.
chinese: 溝通中斷導致了這次延誤。

english: The new drug is a major breakthrough in cancer treatment.
chinese: 這種新藥是癌症治療的一大突破。

english: The ship was carrying cargo from Shanghai to Los Angeles.
chinese: 這艘船載運從上海到洛杉磯的貨物。

english: All cargo must be inspected before it is loaded onto the plane.
chinese: 所有貨物在裝上飛機前都必須接受檢查。

english: The new challenger in the smartphone market is selling at lower prices.
chinese: 智慧型手機市場的新挑戰者以更低的價格銷售。

english: The current champion will face a young challenger in the final.
chinese: 衛冕冠軍將在決賽中迎戰一位年輕的挑戰者。

english: Please chase the supplier for the missing delivery.
chinese: 請向供應商追問那批還沒送到的貨。

english: The general manager is in command of all overseas operations.
chinese: 總經理負責指揮所有海外業務。

english: She has a good command of both English and Japanese.
chinese: 她精通英語和日語。

english: Our commitment to quality has earned us loyal customers.
chinese: 我們對品質的堅持為我們贏得了忠實的顧客。

english: Taking on a second project is a big commitment of time.
chinese: 再接一個專案需要投入大量的時間。

english: The noise from the construction site affected my concentration.
chinese: 工地傳來的噪音影響了我的專注力。

english: The marketing team worked in conjunction with the design team on the campaign.
chinese: 行銷團隊與設計團隊共同合作進行這次宣傳活動。

english: The discount can be used in conjunction with other offers.
chinese: 這個折扣可以與其他優惠合併使用。

english: Missing the deadline could have serious consequences for the company.
chinese: 錯過截止日期可能會對公司造成嚴重的後果。

english: As a consequence of the strike, several flights were canceled.
chinese: 由於罷工，好幾個航班被取消了。

english: Each employee made a contribution to the charity fund.
chinese: 每位員工都為慈善基金捐了款。

english: The new engine uses less fuel than conventional engines.
chinese: 新引擎比傳統引擎更省油。

english: The company took a conventional approach to its advertising.
chinese: 這家公司在廣告上採取了傳統的做法。

english: The conversion of the old warehouse into offices took six months.
chinese: 把舊倉庫改建成辦公室花了六個月。

english: The website shows the currency conversion rate for each country.
chinese: 網站會顯示每個國家的貨幣換算匯率。

english: The publisher owns the copyright to all of the author's books.
